room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "oh-dyoh-vee-ZWEHL": a boy runs the AUDIO-VISUAL cart: a big loudspeaker AND a film projector, sound and pictures at once: oh-dyoh-vee-ZWEHL = AUDIOVISUAL

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "kree-YAHR": the town CRIER in a clashing striped coat rings his bell and shouts his news in a shrill, ear-splitting voice: kree-YAHR = CRIER
note: Pejorative: shrill and grating of a voice, garish of colors (des couleurs criardes).

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "gran-SAHN": a carpenter with a big GRIN SAWS a plank, and the saw squeaks and grates horribly: gran-SAHN = GRIN-SAWN
note: Also biting or sardonic of humor (un humour grinçant).

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "kree-YAHN": a boy shouts at the CRAYON scribbles all over the white gallery wall: a glaring mess! kree-YAHN = CRAYON
note: Mostly glaring or blatant (une injustice criante, une vérité criante); literally, shouting.

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "ew-nah-NEEM": the whole little choir raises their hands at once: a UNANIMOUS yes! ew-nah-NEEM = U-NANIM-ous

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "ahr-moh-NYEUH": three singers hold one sweet HARMONY while a grandpa plays the HARMONica: ar-moh-NYEUH = HARMONY-uh

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "ay-GEW": a baby in a stroller squeals a piercing, high-pitched 'AY-GOO!' and the glasses on the shelf rattle: ay-GEW = AY-GOO
note: Also high-pitched of a sound, acute of a pain or a crisis, and keen of a mind; l'accent aigu is the accent on é.

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "voh-lew-BEEL": a chatterbox girl talks nonstop even while she bounces a VOLLEYBALL: voh-lew-BEEL = VOLLEY-BALL
note: Of a person: talkative, a chatterbox; of a plant: twining.

room_name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
hook: "trahn-BLAHN": a nervous boy at the microphone TREMBLES, knees knocking and voice shaking: trahn-BLAHN = TREMBL-ing
note: Of a voice, hands or a light: shaky; also trembling with fear.

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "KOOL": a COOL kid in sunglasses rides his skateboard past the party: KOOL = COOL
note: Familiar, borrowed from English: cool, relaxed, laid-back.

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "tewr-bew-LAHN": an unruly boy bounces wildly on a TURBO pogo stick through the party: tewr-bew-LAHN = TURBULENT
note: Of a child: rowdy, unruly; of water or air: turbulent.

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "ahk-TEEF": an ACTIVE grandma jumps rope faster than everyone: ahk-TEEF = ACTIVE

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "sahn-sah-syoh-NEHL": a magician pulls a white rabbit out of his top hat: SENSATIONAL! sahn-sah-syoh-NEHL = SENSATIONAL

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "kah-oh-TEEK": a CHAOTIC pile-up: a toppled tower of party chairs, balloons and spilled confetti everywhere: kah-oh-TEEK = CHAOTIC

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "broo-YOHN": a messy boy sweeps with a BROOM but only spreads the confetti everywhere: broo-YOHN = BROOM-yon
note: Of a person or work: messy, disorganized; as a noun, un brouillon is a rough draft.

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "day-kohn-trahk-TAY": a relaxed dad lounges in a DECK chair with his tie undone, totally laid-back: day-kohn-trahk-TAY = DECK-on-TRACK-tay
note: Also casual of clothes or a style (une tenue décontractée).

room_name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
hook: "fehs-TEEF": a girl in a party hat blows a party horn in a FESTIVE shower of streamers: fehs-TEEF = FESTIVE

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "REHD": her long RED hair is perfectly straight and stiff, not one curl: REHD = RED
note: Also steep (un escalier raide) and stiff of muscles; in slang, broke (out of money).

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "foor-NEE": his chin is well FURNISHED: a huge, thick, bushy beard: foor-NEE = FURNI(shed)
note: Thick or bushy of hair or a beard; well-stocked of a shop (une boutique bien fournie).

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "tahn-ZHEEBL": a girl squeezes a real TANGERINE: you can touch it, it's TANGIBLE: tahn-ZHEEBL = TANGI-ble

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "rew-dee-mahn-TEHR": a kid in a caveman costume shows off his RUDIMENTARY stone wheel, just a rough round rock: rew-dee-mahn-TEHR = RUDIMENTARY
note: Also crude or basic in a negative way (des connaissances rudimentaires).

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "groh-SYAY": the young GROCER in her apron shows off a sack of rough, coarse burlap full of potatoes: groh-SYAY = GROCER
note: Most often rude or vulgar (un mot grossier = a swear word); also coarse, crude or shoddy (une erreur grossière = a glaring mistake).

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "LEES": a girl strokes the smooth, sleek coat of a greyhound on a LEASH: LEES = LEASH

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "pahl-PAHBL": a boy holds out the smooth PEBBLE his PAL gave him: you can really feel it, it's PALPABLE: pahl-PAHBL = PAL-PEBBLE

room_name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
hook: "oh-SEUH": 'OH, SEE the bones!' gasps a boy at the X-ray lightbox showing a bony hand: oh-SEUH = OH-SEE
note: Bony or skinny of a face or hands; in science, osseous (le tissu osseux = bone tissue).

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "aht-mohs-fay-REEK": a scientist lets a big white weather balloon rise into the ATMOSPHERE: aht-mohs-fay-REEK = ATMOSPHERIC

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "kahr-boh-NEEK": cold white CARBON dioxide fog spills from a box of dry ice: kahr-boh-NEEK = CARBON-ic
note: Le gaz carbonique = carbon dioxide; la neige carbonique = dry ice.

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "ay-fehr-vay-SAHN": a girl watches an EFFERVESCENT tablet fizz and bubble in a glass of water: ay-fehr-vay-SAHN = EFFERVESCENT

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "san-tay-TEEK": a boy compares a real woolly sheep with a shiny SYNTHETIC fleece: san-tay-TEEK = SYNTHETIC
note: Also a summarizing overview (un esprit synthétique = a mind good at summing up).

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "fee-zyoh-loh-ZHEEK": a doctor shows how the body works on a big see-through PHYSIOLOGY model: fee-zyoh-loh-ZHEEK = PHYSIOLOG-ic
note: Of how the body works (un besoin physiologique = a bodily need).

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "dee-FEW": an aroma DIFFUSER spreads soft mist all through the air: dee-FEW = DIFFUSE
note: Also rambling or wordy of a style.

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "oh-moh-ZHEHN": a girl stirs the paints until the color is one smooth, HOMOGENEOUS mix: oh-moh-ZHEHN = HOMOGEN-eous

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "fohnk-syoh-NEHL": a robot arm actually WORKS: it is FUNCTIONAL and hands a boy a cup: fohnk-syoh-NEHL = FUNCTION-al
note: Also practical of a design; in medicine, functional (a disorder with no physical cause).

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "tehr-MEEK": a girl looks through a THERMAL camera that shows her friend glowing red and yellow: tehr-MEEK = THERM-ic

room_name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
hook: "glah-SYAHL": a boy shivers in front of the icy GLACIER model where a penguin stands: glah-SYAHL = GLACIAL

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "fohn-SAY": a painter paints a baby deer, a FAWN, in deep dark brown and SAYS 'darker!': fohn-SAY = FAWN-SAY
note: Placed after a color: bleu foncé = dark blue; the opposite is clair (light).

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "VAHG": a man squints at a foggy, blurry painting: everything is VAGUE: VAHG = VAGUE
note: Homograph: la vague (noun) is a wave; un vague à l'âme = a vague melancholy.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "shahn-ZHAHN": a chameleon CHANGES color as it creeps along a branch: shahn-ZHAHN = CHANGE-ahn
note: Also moody or fickle of a person.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "sew-pehr-fee-SYEHL": a SUPERhero kid checks his toy car: only a SUPERFICIAL scratch on the paint: sew-pehr-fee-SYEHL = SUPERFICIAL
note: Of a wound: on the surface only; of a person: shallow, which is negative.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "pray-SYEUH": a golden egg rests like a treasure in its velvet nest: so PRECIOUS! pray-SYEUH = PRECIOUS
note: Also affected or precious in manner (un style précieux), mildly negative.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "fahs-TWEUH": a sumptuous golden carriage pulled FAST by TWO white horses: fahs-TWEUH = FAST-TWO
note: Lavish, sumptuous; can hint at showing off.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "mahr-zhee-NAHL": a girl draws tiny pictures down the MARGIN of her sketchbook: mahr-zhee-NAHL = MARGIN-al
note: As a noun, un marginal is a dropout or someone living on the fringe of society, often negative.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "moh-mahn-tah-NAY": a giant soap bubble lasts just a MOMENT before it pops: moh-mahn-tah-NAY = MOMENT-an-ay

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "rah-vee-SAHN": a girl twirls in a RAVISHING flowered dress in front of a tall mirror: rah-vee-SAHN = RAVISH-ing

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "ay-klah-TAHN": a glazed ÉCLAIR gleams so brightly under the lamp that a boy shades his eyes: ay-klah-TAHN = ÉCLAIR-TAN
note: Also resounding of a success or a victory (une victoire éclatante), and dazzling of health or a smile.

room_name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
hook: "kohn-play-mahn-TEHR": a girl holds an orange beside a blue ball: COMPLEMENTARY colors make each other pop: kohn-play-mahn-TEHR = COMPLEMENT-ary
note: Not English 'complimentary' (free), which is gratuit; un complément alimentaire = a dietary supplement.

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "say-VEHR": a SEVERE headmaster frowns over his glasses with his arms folded: say-VEHR = SEVERE
note: Strict of a person; also serious of an illness or a loss (une défaite sévère).

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "an-pea-twah-YAHBL": a little IMP with no PITY hides the last cookie from everyone: an-pi-twah-YAHBL = IMP-PITY-able
note: Merciless; negative of a person, but neutral of a sun or a judge of quality.

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "an-plah-KAHBL": a relentless puppy, IN PLAY, keeps tugging the CABLE no matter what: an-plah-KAHBL = IN-PLAY-CABLE
note: Relentless, unstoppable; of an enemy, implacable (negative).

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "oh-DYEUH": 'OH, DEAR!' sighs a lady as an obnoxious boy cuts in front of the whole line: oh-DYEUH = OH-DEAR
note: Strongly negative: hateful, obnoxious (un enfant odieux = a horrible child).

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "ruh-gahr-DAHN": a stingy man GUARDS his coin purse and won't spend a penny: ruh-gahr-DAHN = re-GUARD-on
note: Usually negative: stingy with money (il est très regardant); also fussy about details (regardant sur la qualité).

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "mohn-DAN": a chic society lady at a fancy party sways in a MOON-DANCE: mohn-DAN = MOON-DANCE
note: Of fashionable society (une soirée mondaine = a society party); also worldly as opposed to spiritual. Not English 'mundane' (banal).

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "groh-TEHSK": a goofy GROTESQUE stone head pulls a ridiculous grin on its pedestal: groh-TEHSK = GROTESQUE
note: Usually ridiculous or absurd rather than ugly.

room_name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
hook: "vay-ree-TAHBL": an expert checks the genuine old table: it's the VERY TABLE of a king! vay-ree-TAHBL = VERY-TABLE
note: Before a noun it also intensifies: un véritable désastre = a real disaster.

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: doors to fete and voix (painting repainted with an orange flower door in the back wall and a red music-note door in the right wall); all boxes re-fit

room_name: Le cabinet du toucher · The cabinet of touch
hook: doors to labo and matieres (painting repainted with a sky-blue flower door in the back wall and a green flower door in the right wall; the fabric shelves were lost); all boxes re-fit

room_name: Le cabinet de la vue · The cabinet of sight
hook: doors to couleurs and caracteres (painting repainted with a lilac flower door in the back wall and a dark wooden flower door in the right wall; the road mural became a framed picture); argenté/éloignement boxes adjusted, éloignement hook reworded
